encryption_details.algorithm: Custom 10-round, 16-byte-block AES-S-box/XOR transform (not standard AES). For each round r=0..9 and byte i=0..15: state[i] = AES_SBOX[state[i]] XOR key[i] XOR ((27*r) & 0xff). There is no AES key schedule, ShiftRows, or MixColumns. It is applied in place to the 32-byte blob at 0x140004000 before the manual PE loader is called.
encryption_details.key_storage: Fixed 16-byte plaintext key in .rdata at VA 0x140005100; it is not separately NUL-terminated and is immediately followed by the plaintext loader lookup string "DllMain".

decoded_strings.note: The transformed object is treated as a binary PE payload, not as text. No encrypted textual strings were recoverable; the key and DllMain lookup string are stored plaintext.

anti_analysis: Direct PEB BeingDebugged test: reads PEB from GS:[0x60] and byte offset +0x2; exits the payload path when nonzero.
Custom at-rest transformation of the embedded 32-byte payload blob to impede straightforward static inspection.
Sleep(2000) delay after the manual-loader attempt.

injection_details.method: Local reflective/manual DLL mapping in the current process; there is no remote-process injection.
injection_details.target_discovery: None. The code does not enumerate or open another process and imports no OpenProcess, WriteProcessMemory, or remote-thread API.
injection_details.payload_source: A 32-byte blob in .data at VA 0x140004000 is copied to a stack buffer and transformed in 16-byte blocks with the custom AES-S-box/XOR routine.
injection_details.payload_write: The mapper validates DOS/NT headers, calls VirtualAlloc first at the payload's preferred ImageBase and then with a NULL base on failure, using MEM_RESERVE|MEM_COMMIT (0x3000) and PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE (0x40). It copies headers and sections with memcpy into the local allocation.
injection_details.loader_fixups: Applies IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64 relocations and rebuilds the IAT using the imported LoadLibraryA and GetProcAddress.
injection_details.execution: Parses the mapped image export table, searches for the name "DllMain", and directly invokes that export as DllMain(mapped_base, DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH, NULL). No thread is created.
injection_details.artifact_note: Only a 32-byte transformed buffer is supplied to a PE manual mapper in this artifact, so it is not a complete embedded PE image; nevertheless, the full local manual-mapping implementation is present.
